# UU AI Society (UUAIS)

> UU AI Society is the student-run Artificial Intelligence society in Uppsala, Sweden, uniting students driven by AI, tech, and meaningful collaboration through workshops, guest lectures, hackathons, and networking. Membership is free.

Key facts:
- Location: Uppsala, Sweden
- Organization: student-led non-profit run entirely by volunteer students
- Membership: free and open to all students
- Pillars: AI knowledge, Community, Innovation, Industry connections
- Events: workshops, guest lectures, hackathons, seminars, and networking
- Contact: contact@uuais.com (general), it@uuais.com (website), dev@uuais.com (development), partnerships@uuais.com (partnerships), research@uuais.com (research)
- Website: https://uuais.com

## Sections
- [Home](https://uuais.com): Landing page — upcoming events, why to join, and membership CTA.
- [About](https://uuais.com/about): Mission, vision, the team behind UU AI Society, contact addresses, and the FAQ.
- [Events](https://uuais.com/events): Upcoming and past AI workshops, guest lectures, hackathons, and networking events.
- [Blog](https://uuais.com/blog): Newsletter and articles published by the society.
- [Careers](https://uuais.com/careers): Job board with internships, master's thesis roles, startup openings, and jobs.
- [Projects](https://uuais.com/projects): Community-built projects, including the Course Navigator.
- [Course Navigator](https://uuais.com/projects/course-navigator): AI-powered tool for navigating Uppsala University courses.
- [Explore Courses](https://uuais.com/explore): Search all Uppsala University courses and get natural-language AI recommendations.
- [My Courses](https://uuais.com/my-courses): Save favorite courses and organize them into custom groups (sign-in required).
- [Study Plan](https://uuais.com/study-plan): Visualize degree pathways and course prerequisites (in development).
- [Join](https://uuais.com/join): Become a member — free membership and newsletter signup.
- [Apply](https://uuais.com/apply): Open team roles and board position applications.
- [Privacy](https://uuais.com/privacy): Privacy policy.
